title: One Flahavan's ad: the 558,741 people it reached in Ireland, by age
unit: number of people in Ireland the ad reached, as Meta's Ad Library gave it on 11 October 2026
footnote: One ad from the Flahavans page for Salted Caramel Flapjacks, Library ID 1481256290703842, which ran from 17 August to 1 October 2026 and was aimed at people aged 25 and over in Ireland. The figures are Meta's, read from its Ad Library on 11 October 2026. Meta's own total for the ad across the EU is 573,712, and the 558,741 is its Ireland rows added up. The five groups add up to 558,734; Meta gives no age for 7 more people.
